page.layout: One block of text in a single column, with Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac words in Hebrew script at the start of many entries. Page number and running head at the top. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: יְלַף Ch. ܐܠܦ Syr. Discere. Idem quod אלף. Pahel יְלַף Docere. Ethpah. Part. ܐܬܝܠܦ Edocti, instructi, Lucæ 21.14. Sic in Targ.Hierof. אִתְיְלַף Docti sunt illi, vel Docuit eos, Levit.10.19. יוּלְפָנָא Chald. & Syr. Doctrina, institutio, instructio. Plur. ܝܘܠܦܢܐ Doctrinæ hominum, ad Colofs.2.8.
יְמָא Ch. ܐܡܐ Syr. Juravit. Aphel ܐܘܡܝ Juravit, adjuravit. Aff.Græc. ὀμνύω, ὄμνυμι.

מוּמְתָא, מוּמְתָא, מוּמָא, מוּמֵי, אוּמָאָה Ch. ܡܘܡܬܐ Syr. Jusjurandum, juramentum, execratio. מוּמֵי דְשַׁקְרָא Juramentum falsum, Jerem.23.10. Plur.emph. ܡܘܡܬܐ: Hinc ܡܘܡܬܐ ܕܡܘܡܬܐ Transgredientes juramenta, perjuri, 1.ad Tim.1.10.
יָמָא יָם Ch. יַמָּא, יַמָּא, יַמָּא Syr. Mare. Plur. יַמְמָא יַמְמִין & יַמָּיָא, יַמִין.
יָמִין Ch. & Syr. Dextera, Dexter, a, um, Dextrum latus.
ܝܡܢܐ Syr. Auster, meridies, meridionalis mundi plaga, quòd ea Orientem aspicientibus dextera sit, & Ventus Australis, Matth.12.42. Luc.12.55. Hebr. תֵּימָן.
יָמַם Ithpahel אִתְיַמַּם Liquescere, diffluere, Genef.49. 10.Lev.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac script is transcribed approximately; several Syriac and pointed Hebrew forms are uncertain and may contain errors. Marginal text on the faint back-side show-through was omitted.
